description.value: The study examined the relationship between alcohol and nicotine dependence severity and quantity of use and gray matter density in heavy drinking smokers using voxel-based morphometry.

spans.text: The purpose of the present study was to examine the relationship between quantity of alcohol/nicotine use and alcohol/nicotine dependence severity with gray matter density in heavy drinking smokers.

value: We hypothesized that gray matter would be negatively related to quantity of both alcohol and nicotine use, in regions such as the middle frontal gyrus.

We also hypothesized that dependence severity scores would uniquely relate to gray matter atrophy in several regions previously identified across the meta-analyses of voxel-based morphometry studies, such as the ACC, dorsal striatum, and insula.

spans.text: Based on previous findings, we hypothesized that gray matter density would be negatively related to quantity of both alcohol and nicotine use, in regions such as the middle frontal gyrus.
